title: Tired Zverev Is Proud of His Shanghai Run
summary:
German tennis star Alexander Zverev made it to the semifinals of the Shanghai Masters. Then he lost. Afterward, he said he had "overachieved," or done better than expected, because he was so tired.

Zverev is ranked number two in the world. He has played many tournaments in a row, including the US Open and the Laver Cup, with little time to rest. He said he came to Shanghai a bit hurt and tired.

In the semifinal, Zverev won the first set against Davidovich Fokina. But his opponent came back and won the deciding third set.

"We're all human beings, even the best players in the world," Zverev said.

It has still been a great year for him. He won the French Open in June and the US Open in September. He will also finish the year as world number one, the first German man to do so.

Davidovich Fokina will play fellow Spaniard Rafael Jodar in the final on Sunday.
why_it_matters: Even top athletes get tired, which is a reminder that rest matters for everyone.
